card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings and warnings
card.fires_on: Capitalized words or word pieces inside ALL-CAPS headings and warning sentences, right after a linking word such as AND, OR, SHOULD or A. It fires on the next capitalized piece, often the start of a split word.

modes.label: Split word in caps heading
modes.description: The first piece of a long capitalized word after AND or OR in a section heading.
modes.example: LIFE HISTORY AND<< E>>COLOGY: Monogamous; pair

modes.label: Caps warning sentence
modes.description: A word inside an all-caps warning sentence, such as BE after SHOULD or AIR in PATENT AIRWAY.
modes.example: BEFORE INITIATING THERAPY WITH PENICILLIN V POTASSIUM, CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD<< BE>> MADE CONCERNING PREVIOUS HY

card.writes: No clear theme; it may weakly suppress manufacturing-related words and favor continuation of the capitalized text.
card.plain: It lights up on the next word in all-capital headings and warning text, especially where a long word is split.
